messages:
alex_cs: Heads up — Clearwave Labs just asked for a concentrated enablement wave for three customer cohorts next week. They want live workshops + office hours + recorded how-tos. Can we triage facilitators, rough agenda, and feedback capture?

maria_success: I can run one of the cohort sessions (APAC-friendly). What days/times are they thinking?

alex_cs: They suggested Mon/Tue/Wed next week, mornings in PST (so evening EMEA). Proposed windows: 9:00–10:30 PST or 11:00–12:30 PST. Preference for 90m hands-on + 30m office hours afterwards.

tony_se: I can take the technical deep-dive (runtime/ops) for one cohort. Want me to prep a short demo that walks through Dedicated vs Hosted fallbacks?

claire_enablement: I’ll own the kickoff agenda + the feedback form. Recommend we use the short adoption survey we used for Meridian (3 Qs + NPS). I can reuse that template and add a question about rollback concerns.

priya_ps: Heads-up — Clearwave has a renewal conversation in 6 weeks. Adoption speed is a renewal signal. We should flag this internally as medium risk and make sure we capture success metrics during the wave (API calls, top routes instrumented).

alex_cs: Good call Priya. For success metrics let's collect: number of teams onboarded, number of successful inference calls in their staging env, two quick example prompts they can run. Claire, can you include a metrics checklist in the post-session survey?

claire_enablement: Yup. Draft agenda (we can shorten to 60m if needed):
```
- 0–10m: Welcome + success criteria (CS)
- 10–30m: Quick architecture review and routing policies (SE)
- 30–60m: Hands-on: deploy sample flow + validate KV cache behavior (live)
- 60–90m: Q&A + office hours sign-up sheet
```

maria_success: For timezones — I'll run the APAC-friendly cohort at 15:00 SGT (which maps to 2:00 PST) — not ideal, but they have regional engineers. Maybe rotate so no one always does the late slot.

tony_se: Can we get a prebuilt repo link + docker image for the demo? devex-bot, any chance of a quick publish to our shared enablement bucket?

devex-bot: alex_cs requested publish to enablement-bucket:enablement-waves/clearwave. Upload template repo (pending). ETA ~4 hours. :robot_face:

alex_cs: Thanks — if devex-bot can stage the repo and Claire can share the feedback link, I’ll schedule calendar invites and a simple RSVP poll. For the poll, drop two preferred clusters (Hosted fast lane vs Dedicated reserved) so we can tailor the demos.

claire_enablement: Draft feedback form and RSVP poll links: https://tiny.redwood/clearwave-rsvp (poll), https://tiny.redwood/clearwave-feedback (survey). Shared with the thread.

priya_ps: Also add a required checkbox on the RSVP for "I confirm I have a staging API key" so we can avoid sessions where attendees can't run the hands-on.

maria_success: :thumbsup: I'll post the cohort-specific invites once Alex shares final times. Who should be in the facilitator rotation? Alex, Tony, Claire, and me?

alex_cs: That works. Tony — please prepare a 10-slide deck + demo steps. Claire — finalize survey + success-metrics checklist. I'll handle invites, calendar, and renewal signal briefing for the CSM lead.

tony_se: On it. Will upload slides to the enablement folder and drop the link here when ready.

claire_enablement: Uploaded survey and checklist to the repo. Link: https://tiny.redwood/clearwave-resources. Added the NPS + adoption checkpoint.

alex_cs: Awesome. Last thing — capture any red flags during sessions in the shared doc (Clearwave-Risks) so we can surface blockers before renewal. Thanks everyone.

maria_success: Noted. I'll take session 1 (APAC), Tony session 2 (EMEA), Claire session 3 (AMER).

devex-bot: Calendar invites created for tentative times. Update once final times set.

alex_cs: Closing loop — final times pushed to invites and resources link in the invite. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your prep tasks.

maria_success: :white_check_mark:

tony_se: :white_check_mark:

claire_enablement: :white_check_mark:

priya_ps: I'll join the kickoff and monitor adoption metrics.

alex_cs: Thanks team — we'll follow up after the wave for a quick retro and to compile the feedback summary for the renewal owner.
